runs.text: Israel versus eight countries. Seven numbers. One: happiness. Israel beats all eight, eighth in the world. Two: research. Israel spends the most, almost double anyone here. Three: life expectancy. Only Japan beats Israel. Four: babies. Israel tops the chart, above Egypt and Jordan. Five: median age. Israel, twenty nine. Germany and Japan, over forty five. Six: soldiers per thousand people. Israel, sixteen. Twice Jordan, four times America. Israel drafts at eighteen. <<h|ɑ|ˈ|m|ɑ|s>> and <<ˌ|h|ɛ|z|b|ə|ˈ|l|ɑ>> sit on its borders. Seven: money per person. Only America is richer. Adjusted for prices, Israel drops to sixth. Japan lives longer, America earns more. Israel is happiest. Which number surprised you?
